name: muft-captions-v2
description: Caption editor with word-level timing, a data-driven template engine, and burned-in MP4 export.

scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check src/caption-utils.js && node --check src/composition-engine.js

scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:ui && npm run test:wysiwyg && npm run test:export
